presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Exploded plan with the default pieces: the chart comes from the exhibit (relation) and is explained to the participants (communication); once the tracer reaches the board the chart settles on it with its reference, its span is marked, the explanation card comes out and the connector is drawn; both places get the same neutral frame.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: four participants and another specialist, the places in the other order, two exhibits and the chart from the second one; a link from the specialist to the board (the specialist stands further from the board to leave floor for it), other captions, a traversal from the specialist and the specialist as focus.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: four participants with long labels, a long reference and caption, two exhibits, a twelve-point chart, long element labels and relationship captions.
presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 the exploded plan is narrow; the specialist stands right beside the board with the exhibit cabinet lifted above, so the specialist's label has only the strip of floor beside the lectern (it must stand nearer its own element than any other), and the near-maximum label (48 characters) wraps to four lines there. Tried before capping: every column and band arrangement, band shares 0.24–0.42, room scales 1–1.4 on both sides, the 45 px stress floor, the label allowed above the wall. Rendered BEFORE (production/scratch/hearings-07/capmeasure.mjs, hold, 1080p): 16:9 18.9 px / people 61.3 px; 9:16 19.8 / 94.5; 1:1 16.4 / 46.7 with label-specialist. AFTER the cap (specialist label of 36 characters; every other field unchanged): 16:9 18.9 / 61.3; 9:16 19.8 / 94.5; 1:1 17.1 / 46.1 (>= 45 px stress floor); no problems. The capped label stays longer than its baseline (25 characters). Pre-cap preset: production/scratch/hearings-07/LAW-0306.presets.precap.json.
